answer: Each identity claims a ridge plot on the tundra and locks 70 credits, filing a ridge census count to a vault ledger each epoch. Auditors replay the vault, burning the bond on a duplicated count or reused serial. First filing costs 38; the k-th fake pays 38+6(k-1) as new plots lie farther out. 1,000 fakes pay 3,035,000 plus 70,000 locked against a 40,000 pool, so a rented-census ring loses. An honest identity files once for 38 and keeps its bond.
